description: This Java source file defines the ShipmentEvents class, which contains event handler methods related to shipment processing in the OFBiz framework, including viewing shipment package route segment label images and checking shipment receipt status.

classes.name: ShipmentEvents
classes.description: Contains static methods for handling shipment-related events such as viewing label images and updating shipment status.

methods.name: viewShipmentPackageRouteSegLabelImage
methods.description: Streams the label image associated with a shipment package route segment to the browser, handling different image formats and errors.

methods.name: checkForceShipmentReceived
methods.description: Checks if a shipment should be marked as received based on request parameters and updates the shipment status accordingly.
